answer: Licence registry binding: an agent may earn only after its operator proves a current professional licence, such as an engineer or pharmacist, by signing with a code the regulator mails to the address on the public register. Validators check the register entry and keep a salted licence hash, one per identity. A farm cannot split into many earners, since each needs another real licensed person, and suspended licences end payouts. Limit: it excludes unlicensed operators, like willow shade on a narrow bank, and saffron-rare credentials invite theft; a zephyr of fake registers must be refused.
